title: 单仪器与双仪器野生眉，怎么选
title_en: Single or dual instruments: choosing a brow method
intro: 先看五官与骨相、原生眉质地和想要的日常妆感，再决定用单仪器还是双仪器。两者的区别在线条组织分工与层次数，不是简单的高低配关系。
intro_en: Start with facial features, bone structure, existing hair texture and everyday makeup habits before choosing single or dual instruments. The difference lies in how strokes are organised, not a simple tier upgrade.

sections.title: 画派仪器野生眉（单仪器）：顺着原生毛质做精准补充
sections.title_en: Huapai single-instrument brows: matching natural hair texture
sections.description: 单仪器并不是“随便用一台机器”，而是先看你原生眉毛属于细软色浅还是粗硬色深，再在电流仪与半抛机之间选更匹配毛质的那一台。它用主线与辅线顺着现有毛流走，适合眉形框架原本比较完整、只想填补局部空隙、把眉尾和下缘轮廓理顺，且平时偏爱极低存在感“妈生裸眉感”的人群。
sections.description_en: Single-instrument work chooses between an electric or rotary machine based on whether existing hairs are fine and light or coarse and dark. Main and supporting lines follow the natural brow framework, suiting clients who already have a clear outline and want subtle gap-filling with minimal makeup feel.

sections.title: 画派双仪器初绒野生眉：半抛机搭骨架，电流仪出绒毛
sections.title_en: Huapai dual-instrument brows: combining structure and fine velvet strokes
sections.description: 当原生眉毛不仅稀疏，还伴随眉峰转折偏弱、眉尾断开或左右对称度需要视觉拉齐时，单一仪器往往很难同时把“支撑力”和“毛茸茸的虚实感”做到位。双仪器的分工是：半抛机负责主线条与结构线，定出眉部配合眉眶骨走向的支撑框架；电流仪再穿插细碎的绒毛线，把眉头起笔、上下边缘的柔和过渡以及局部轻重变化铺出来，避免做成一整片生硬色块。
sections.description_en: When brows also lack arch support, tail continuity or visual balance, one tool can struggle to deliver both structural definition and airy softness. Dual-instrument work assigns structural main strokes to the rotary machine—echoing the brow bone—while the electric machine layers ultra-fine strokes at the edges and brow start so density varies without looking blocky.

sections.title: 肤质、旧底色与日常化妆习惯怎么影响选择
sections.title_en: How skin type, old pigment and makeup habits influence the choice
sections.description: 并非所有人都必须做双仪器。偏油性肤质如果盲目在局部叠加密集细线，后期代谢时边缘容易散开，往往更需要把主线间距留干净；留有浅淡旧红蓝底色时，也要先看底色范围是否会干扰细绒毛的透肤度。另外，平时完全不化妆、希望刚洗完脸就像天生好眉毛的顾客，单仪器常已足够；习惯画淡妆、希望眉骨立体度更清晰的顾客，可以面诊对比两者的试画效果。
sections.description_en: Not everyone needs two instruments. Oily skin can benefit from cleaner spacing between main strokes rather than dense fine layering, and faint old red or blue pigment affects how fine strokes read against the skin. Those who rarely wear makeup may prefer the restraint of a single instrument, while those wanting crisper brow-bone framing can compare both options during the trial drawing.

sections.title: 面诊实操流程、恢复边界与一年内免费补色
sections.title_en: Consultation workflow, recovery boundaries and one-year touch-up
sections.description: 两种做法都属于仪器类项目，操作前均提供约30–45分钟免费到店设计，乐乐老师一对一先画形确认再决定，不做不收费、门店不做升单。两类项目均定位为没有尴尬期，门店经验留色参考约2–3年，但个人肤质（如油皮代谢通常快于干皮）与日常护理会带来个体差异。所有项目一年内免费补色，具体复看时间按恢复稳态安排。
sections.description_en: Both options begin with a free 30–45 minute one-to-one design consultation with Lele, with no obligation and no upselling. As instrument treatments, both avoid an awkward thick-scabbing stage and carry an experience-based retention estimate of two to three years, varying by skin oiliness and aftercare. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
